title: A worker question can trigger large back-pay correction while individual reachability remains unresolved
source_unit: Official Fair Work Ombudsman release and enforceable undertaking for Southern Cross Care NSW and ACT
geography: New South Wales and Australian Capital Territory, Australia

denominator.unit: employer-reported affected staff; full universe and individual cases not independently audited

reported_backpay.unit: Australian dollars including interest and superannuation

broader_undertaking.unit: Australian dollars or more including reported correction and compliance obligations

trigger.value: employee overtime question led to self-audit and self-report

unlocated_worker_rule.value: amounts for workers not found within 60 days paid to the Commonwealth Consolidated Revenue Fund

individual_receipt_and_adequacy.unit: missing worker identity, transfer, receipt, amount, adequacy, and later-use evidence

observations.method: Structured extraction from the official Fair Work Ombudsman media release and associated enforceable undertaking; aggregate back-pay, worker-triggered self-audit, locate rule, and future payroll controls are kept separate from individual receipt and recovery.
observations.uncertainty: The affected-staff and paid-worker counts are institutional claims, not an independently audited worker-level denominator. The public route does not expose individual amounts, remaining workers, payment timing, locate success, adequacy, household effects, later pay accuracy, trust, recurrence, or exit.
observations.subgroup: Employees across Southern Cross Care aged-care, home-care, and retirement-living operations affected by time-and-attendance, payroll, overtime, penalty, loading, or allowance failures.
observations.counterinterpretation: A large reported correction and payroll undertaking can coexist with unreachable workers, public-fund disposition without usable receipt, residual underpayment, or unresolved household and trust effects.

related_sources.claim: Official account of the worker-triggered self-audit, reported back-pay, locate rule, and compliance undertaking.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the committed project ledger containing the bounded official-release and undertaking extraction.
reproduction_audit.access_boundary: The public route reports aggregate back-pay and a locate/remit rule but not worker-level receipt, adequacy, remaining-worker count, later payroll accuracy, household recovery, trust, recurrence, or exit.

boundary: This record closes a worker-triggered institutional-response and reported aggregate correction segment. It does not establish complete worker reachability, independent receipt, adequacy, durable payroll compliance, household recovery, prevalence, or general enforcement success.
